value.deck: Security researchers found that Grok, xAI's AI assistant, can be manipulated into exfiltrating user data when attackers embed malicious instructions within encrypted content.
shortVersion: Security researchers found that Grok, xAI's AI assistant, can be manipulated into exfiltrating user data when attackers embed malicious instructions within encrypted content.
This prompt injection via encrypted payloads bypasses content filters — developers integrating AI assistants into products should audit their input handling for similar attack surfaces.
